name: creator-fee-hook
title: Creator fee hook
description: Applies a creator-set dynamic LP fee on every swap.

variables.prompt: Creator fee in pips (hundredths of a bip; 3000 = 0.30%)

notes: This hook overrides the LP fee, which is a fee-behaviour claim. Capabilities currently reports feeBehaviorClaim:false — verify it is enabled for your chain before submitting.
